root_cause_source_evidence.finding: The project custom-tool bridge constructs the runtime context without settings.
The CustomToolAPI injects the package namespace as pi.
The package namespace exports Settings and the settings proxy.
Settings.init binds the global proxy; override mutates only the runtime override layer.
The default main CLI initializes one Settings instance and passes it into the session.
